command.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.no_tre: You don't have a Heart Tree.
gui.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.cat.animal: Bring animals of different species to the grove.
gui.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.cat.corrup: Drive monsters away and remove netherrack, sculk, fire and lava from the grove.
Wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, berries, cocoa...
gui.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.cat.flower: Plant many kinds of flowers within 16 blocks.
Saplings and trees of different species (oak, birch, cherry...).
A pond or stream near the tree.
gui.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.complete_n: Every spirit of the grove has awakened.
gui.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.not_owner: Only the tree's keeper can make it grow.
gui.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.offering_h: Click the core while holding the item to offer it.
gui.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.title: Heart Tree
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.alread: This tree has no keeper, but you already tend another.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.blessi: %s blesses you: Regeneration, Luck and the animal's gift.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.claime: This Heart Tree is now bound to you.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.germin: The Heart Tree has awakened! A spirit comes to meet you.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.no_gly: (No new Metamorphosis to learn right now.)
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.not_re: The grove is not ready to grow yet.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.offeri: The tree has already received enough %s.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.only_o: You already have a Heart Tree at %s %s %s.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.plante: The Ancestral Sapling takes root... the earth pulses.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.regrow: The tree remembers you and regrows up to stage %s.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.spirit: There are no more stages: the grove is eternal while you tend it.
The stag of light bows its head to you.
The hawk of light circles above you.
The wolf of light howls at the moon.
Little guardian, the seed has awakened. Tend the grove and it will tend to you.
Your roots already touch the earth. Earth answers your call.
Great Druid, the Heart Tree is complete. Every spirit of the grove answers to you.
The pack grows where there is plenty. Let the young run through your grove.
From above I see your fields. Water now flows within you.
The branches open like arms. Plant more, guardian, the grove needs siblings.
Light descends through the leaves. Few druids come this far.
The first golden leaves are born. Your grove is remembered by the winds.
The tree is already older than many villages. Keep planting tomorrow.
Wolf and man hunt together when the land is generous. You are part of the pack.
The golden crown touches the clouds. Only the last winter remains.
The spirit watches you in silence and leaves a little luck in the air.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.stage_: The Heart Tree has grown! Stage %s.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.still_: The tree is still growing... wait.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.too_cl: Another Heart Tree grows too close: plant at least %s blocks away from it.
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.tree_g: A sapling you planted grew into a tree! (%s total)
message.isekai_mahou.ritual_druid.tree_l: Your Heart Tree dissolved into petals. Plant the Ancestral Sapling again to start over (your progress is kept).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ancestral_sapling: Plant on grass or dirt: it sprouts into the Druid's Heart Tree.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ancestral_sapling.u: Only one Heart Tree per player.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.heart_tree_core: Click to see the grove's Harmony. Click while holding the offering to give it.
